titleByLocale.fr: Directeur des ventes directes - Diagnostics Roche

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It's what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That's what ma kes us Roche. This role is based in the Diagnostics division where we focus on sustaining and increasing market share in existing accounts through high-value medical solutions. We operate with a customer-centric and holistic approach, delivering innovative proposals to our key stakeholders, clients, and patients to drive long-term business growth and sustainability. The Opportunity As the Direct Sales Manager, your main focus will be to achieve commercial objectives by innovating, co-creating, and identifying new business opportunities. You will build deep relationships with key accounts to implement comprehensive, high-value medical diagnostic solutions.
• You plan and execute commercial growth strategies in existing and new markets by interpreting data and utilizing market insights.
• You build and maintain strategic networking relationships with high-level account stakeholders, including C-level executives, presidents, financial directors, medical directors, and laboratory heads.
• You monitor and manage institutional budgets, expenditures, and revenues to protect and maximize organizational profitability.
• You design effective commercial strategies, tailored sales presentations, and communication action plans that address specific client needs.
• You collaborate cross-functionally with internal departments such as Logistics, Production, and Finance to ensure solutions align with operational capabilities.
• You analyze the competitive landscape, target markets, and public/private market data to identify differentiators and increase overall market share.
• You manage and lead engagement spaces with potential new clients to expand relationships and secure new business opportunities.
• You negotiate commercial conditions, evaluate operational or legal risks, and implement continuous improvement actions to maximize customer satisfaction. ​ Who you are
• You hold a University Degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Health Sciences, Business Administration, or a related field.
• You possess years of professional experience within the Diagnostic Industry.
• You possess years of successful experience in commercial, sales management, or marketing functions & p roven track record of leading high-performance teams.
• You have a strong strategic and systemic vision, with the proven ability to interpret complex market data and translate it into successful action plans.
• You demonstrate excellent interpersonal and communication skills, allowing you to easily build environments of trust and manage stress effectively.
• You are highly motivated, adaptive to change, resilient, and thrive in an Agile and collaborative team environment.
• Advanced English and Spanish are required for this role. Location: Based in Quito, Ecuador. Reporting to: Commercial Director of Diagnostics. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products.
